reviews.title: To add a recipe you need to pay
reviews.text:
They want money for the simplest most basic feature. What I have seen so far it’s not worth £10 per month.
 

Update for response:
In the free recipe creator you need to add ingredients ONE BY ONE and for a single recipe with 10+ ingredients that would take 30 minutes because of who poor the UX/UI is. For a person who actually knows how to cook and uses a diverse range of recipes that’s not okay. I don’t want to import recipes from websites, I want to paste a block of text from my own recipes.

And to add I’ve been calorie tracking for over a decade using xcel/paper and that is quicker than having to use this app. And with AI being so easy access and use now for quick breakdowns and tracking this app doesn’t bring anything to the table.

reviews.title: It's okay
reviews.text: Mixed feelings about this app. Pros: it's better than some others out there such as Lifesum especially if you want to track your micronutrients. Cons: cumbersome UI / UX, no way to quickly just insert calories you want to track without creating extensive custom foods or recipes, and no lifetime subscription because they want to drain you monthly like every other service out there. Most of their data comes from public sources so the app is now easily vibe-coded.

reviews.title: Not Recommended
reviews.text: This app is so frustrating that I have to eat the 60-dollar subscription and stop using it. If you eat only big company foods it might be better but just try to tell it you had a slice of pizza from your local restaurant. The app is hard to navigate and the voice doesn’t always work. Find a better app. They’re out there.

reviews.title: Useless streak notification you can’t turn off.
reviews.text: Dropping to 1 star because now I get unwanted “streak notifications” even though I’ve tried everything under the sun to turn them off. Look- I just want to log my food. If you insist on shoving extra UI garbage down our throats, at least let us turn it off.

reviews.title: Not sure why it’s still in the App Store - doesn’t work!!!
reviews.text:
I have used this app in the past and have just recently come back to using Cronometer.  However, the desktop app DOES NOT work!!!  Whenever I launch it, all I get is the Chronometer logo on a black background.  I contacted Chronometer support and was told that the app is no longer supported on the desktop. Yet, I see from the version history that it was updated a week ago!  Who updated it?  Why?  And why does it still not work???


For the developers: my review is based on the desktop app for my MacBook. I was referencing the Mac App Store, not the iPhone App Store. The iPhone app is terrific!

reviews.title: David’s review
reviews.text:
Cronometer has a lot to offer in theory, but logging food takes far longer than it should. The database is cluttered with overly specific entries, and the search isn't smart enough to cut through them.

Basic foods are the biggest problem. Searching "strawberries," "apple," or "banana" doesn't bring up a simple result. Instead, I have to dig through entries like "fresh cut strawberries" or "raw banana, peeled." Preparation methods are just as frustrating: finding whether a potato is listed as fried, baked, or oven-roasted is surprisingly difficult.

The search also has no tolerance for typos. In MyFitnessPal, if I accidentally type "chucken," chicken still comes up. In Cronometer, one wrong letter returns no results at all, so I have to retype the whole search, which is especially annoying with longer ones like "McDonald's chicken nuggets."

My only other complaint is that setting the app to the Action Button requires Premium, which feels like a basic feature that shouldn't be behind a paywall.

Outside of these issues the app is solid. A more flexible, forgiving search bar would make a huge difference.

Now I’m looking for an alternative because I’m getting frustrated as I’m attempting to manage my weight again.

reviews.title: Full of Ads
reviews.text:
i've been using this app for almost a year now. Most stuff works alright. I've been using and adblock until recently so I haven't noticed but this app is unusable without one. You get spammed with multiple ads whenever you are trying to use the app. While you are trying to track your deficit friendly chicken spaghetti, you get bambozzled with a big mcburger every 30 seconds on the whole screen and you cant close the ad untill half of it plays out. 
this is unusable as it is. not to mention the ammount of foods not existing in the data base. almost every day you have to add new stuff to the database yourself.
looking to switch to eat&track soon. that app sucks too but maybe it sucks less.

reviews.title: very hard to use this app now

Not sure what happened. I may need to go back to either My Fitness Pal or Loseit.

reviews.title: I make my meals
reviews.text: This app is designed for people who eat prepackaged foods not for people who eat food from their garden or make their own meals. It’s really difficult & time consuming to add ingredients that I put into a salad or food that I make. Yes you can create meals but unless you eat them over & over again it seems like a waste of time

reviews.title: No safeguards in place
reviews.text: I was shocked that the app allowed me to set a weight loss goal that resulted in a daily calorie target of just 554 calories. I did not knowingly choose such a low intake, and I feel the safeguards and warnings around this are not sufficient. I am particularly concerned about the potential impact this could have on people vulnerable to eating disorders, and as a result I no longer feel comfortable using the app.

Truly disgraceful.

reviews.title: A really poor customer experience
reviews.text:
I paid for a year’s worth of premium membership. A short while ago I set up two factor authentication which came with a ten digit backup code, which has been misplaced. I contacted customer service from the email I have on the account, and they’ve refused to believe I am who I am. They insist on having a call with me to prove my identity. Excuse me?

This app is supposed to be easy. The team who run this clearly do not understand what easy is. I will be looking elsewhere once this subscription expires. I implore others to do the same.

reviews.title: Previous subscriber, binned for idiotic recommendations
reviews.text:
Initial experience was positive, and I’ve been a user for more than 3 years but of late this app has become more clunky, cluttered and frankly the database of foods more and more challenging to use.  

Just one example, a product that from trade name  search was suggested - only a little over 100kCal difference between the ‘best match’ and reality… on a global product where the total kCal for the serving is 25!

Had wondered why my diet was not working, am guessing it’s a lot of bad data since one over-estimated product also probably reflects that a lot are going to be understated too.

When flagged to customer support the response was derisory and implying I was stupid for not realising it was the wrong product which is apparently available on a different continent. Huh? What ever happened to customer ‘service’ rather than arrogant ignorant people abusing customers.
